entries.505cfdbdb030074b: Under the 15th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2025–2027), which started in April 2025, the company has set “Strengthening Sales Capabilities,” “Strengthening Technical Capabilities” and “Strengthening Human Resources” as priority themes, in order to continue the three challenges set out in its long-term vision “UEKI VISION 150.” It is pursuing research and development of new construction technologies, promoting DX, and creating a workplace environment where people can find their work rewarding. Given the shortage and aging of construction engineers and skilled workers, it has set “strengthening human resources” as one of its management issues, and is also working on personnel exchange and development across the entire group and on promoting labor-saving and manpower-saving measures.
